title: “Too Much Thermal Paste” – Benchmark of Thermal Paste Quantity
summary: Gamers Nexus benchmarks how the amount and application method of thermal paste affect CPU cooling. It compares pea-sized dots, thin spreads and large blobs with Thermal Grizzly Kryonaut.
why: HN cites it as data that too much thermal paste is mostly a myth and that too little is the real risk.

quote.text: Too much paste is fine; too little is not.
